description: Facts about one National Assembly bill by its bill number: English title, current stage and date, filing date, effective dates when promulgated, a one-line summary of what the bill proposed as filed, and links. committee_alternative = a replacement bill drafted by a committee, whose filing date can be later than its committee or judiciary dates.

bill_no.description: Seven-digit National Assembly bill number, e.g. "2216797".
